cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Outfeel the Room
cards.instruction: Answer every fear, sacrifice, or disappointment with one of your own that deserves more attention.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One sleepless night? When I coached your first interview you slept like a log. I've been awake all week about mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I just need you to practise questions with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then listen to an advanced answer. Ask why I left my last job; you'll see what a difficult interview actually sounds like.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm scared I'll cry before they offer me a chair. You're quite capable of asking the questions now. Start with hello, and let me get through it.
